state_contract.candidate_only: Source and use basis are recorded, but no exact object or generated output has been fingerprinted.
state_contract.fingerprinted: An exact private identity record exists. It can enter an acceptance workflow only when global fingerprint activation, approved tool identities, canonical CLI regeneration and live ffprobe evidence all pass.
state_contract.rejected: The candidate failed a source, license, identity or technical suitability gate and cannot enter native testing.

sources.license_or_use_basis: Original deterministic test fixture source, sidecar text and recipes will be created in this GPL-3.0-only project; external tools are identified separately and do not supply the fixture copyright basis.
Netflix states that its open source content is available under CC BY 4.0; attribution and license-link duties apply.
Official FFmpeg filter documentation is the recipe reference; generated outputs still require exact tool and recipe identity.
BT.2111 defines PQ and HLG test-pattern semantics; it is a specification reference, not permission to redistribute an ITU document or third-party asset.
Official x265 documentation defines static and dynamic HDR metadata inputs; any generated fixture remains structural test media until independently verified.
MIT-licensed tooling can generate structural profile fixtures, but Dolby Vision output and redistribution claims require separate capability and legal review.

deferred_external_options.license_or_use_basis: The Blender open movie is CC BY 3.0, but the exact downloadable encode, access path and colour signalling still require selection and probe.
deferred_external_options.deferred_reason: Synthetic SDR is smaller and gives controlled ramp values; keep this as a natural-content comparison candidate.

deferred_external_options.license_or_use_basis: Official EBU HLG colour bars are available for engineering tests; an explicit redistribution licence was not verified.
deferred_external_options.deferred_reason: Use only as an unchanged local reference after separate acquisition approval; do not commit or publish it.

deferred_external_options.license_or_use_basis: The content owner offers a free HDR10+ system test, but no explicit redistribution or derivative licence was verified and delivery may be transient.
deferred_external_options.deferred_reason: Prefer it as an unchanged local comparison only after URL and licence revalidation; it is not consortium certification media.

deferred_external_options.license_or_use_basis: The conformance repository includes CC BY-NC-ND material; an exact asset must remain unchanged and non-commercial, with its own licence read-back.
deferred_external_options.deferred_reason: A 10-bit AV1 label does not prove HDR; exact transfer, primaries and metadata must be probed before case binding.

deferred_external_options.license_or_use_basis: The official test system publishes vector hashes, but an explicit media redistribution licence was not verified.
deferred_external_options.deferred_reason: A vector name does not prove Profile 2, bit depth or HDR; use only after exact probe and local-use review.

deferred_external_options.license_or_use_basis: ITU hosts public conformance bitstreams, but an explicit redistribution licence was not verified.
deferred_external_options.deferred_reason: HEVC Main10 conformance is not HDR10 evidence and elementary streams do not prove container, timeline or colour-output behavior.
